name: AI Butterfly
source:
John is a downer who spends his life avoiding people while Psyche is an energetic optimist whose one wish is to catch a butterfly. Can she change his perspective on life?

[From [URL=http://renai.us/game/aibutterfly.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[URL]]
translation:
约翰是一个消沉的人，整天躲避着人群；而赛姬则是一个充满活力的乐观主义者，唯一的愿望是抓住一只蝴蝶。她能改变他对人生的看法吗？

[来自[URL=http://renai.us/game/aibutterfly.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[URL]]
